skills.name: Morning Brief
skills.description: Daily brief: overnight data + research → top 3 opportunities + today's jobs
skills.content:
# Morning Brief

Read vault/wiki/brand + latest vault/outputs/reports/data snapshot + new reports + completed hub jobs (vault/raw/inbox/done). Produce: yesterday's numbers, top 3 opportunities (each mapped to a skill), today's content jobs, risks. Save to vault/outputs/reports/briefs/. Never invent numbers — say 'no data yet'. Full skill: .claude/skills/morning-brief/SKILL.md

# Weekly Review
